name: Kalo Soldier
body:
KALO SOLDIER
CR 2

XP 600
Kalo soldier 3
NG Medium monstrous humanoid (aquatic)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, sonar; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +4 armor)
hp 24 (3d10+0+3)
Fort +3, Ref +4, Will +5
Resist cold 5; Weaknesses water dependent

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 50 ft.
Melee sentinel spear +6 (1d8+3 P/×3)
Ranged repeating speargun +6 (1d8 P/×3, 20-ft. range incr., 6-dart capacity)

STATISTICS

Str 15 (+2), Dex 16 (+3), Con 11 (+0), Int 10 (+0), Wis 14 (+2), Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +3; CMB +5; CMD 18
Feats Opening Volley, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Technologist, Threedimensional Tactics*
Skills Acrobatics +8 (+4 to jump), Perception +5, Profession (soldier) +8, Stealth +5 (+9 in water), Swim +9; Species Modifiers +4 Stealth in water
Languages Common, Kalo
SQ fighter training, primary fighting style (hit-and-run)
Gear microcord armor, sentinel spear, repeating speargun (20 darts, 50 charges of air), kalo water rebreathing apparatus, other gear

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Sonar (Ex)

You have an innate sonar ability that grants you blindsight 60 feet if you are underwater against creatures touching the same body of water. Above water, you instead have blindsense to a range of 15 feet. This is a sound-dependent ability and is negated if you cannot hear, such as if you are deafened or under the effect of a silence spell 24

ABOUT

Kalos are green-skinned humanoids with membranes between their arms and legs that make them look like manta rays—or some would say bats flying—when they swim through the water. Despite not breathing air, they are naturally curious and outgoing, and have become one of the more active species involved in Galactic trade and exploration. While usually peaceful, they are well-adapted to dealing with the dangers of the icy depths, and are quite valiant warriors when the situation is called for.
